 Oral Order
4 10-04-2025 Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of the I.P.C.
3.
Earlier notices were issued to O.P. No. 2 and the matter was referred to mediation center for reaching amicable settlement.

It appears from the report of the mediation center that the matter has been settled between the parties and the learned counsel for the petitioner submits Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.74988 of 2024(4) dt.10-04-2025 that pursuant to the same both the parties are staying together as husband and wife.
4. Learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 is, however, not appearing today but a report of the mediation center would show that both the husband and wife(O.P. No. 2) have made their respective signature along with other advocates on the agreement made before the mediation center.

sentences.text: In such view of the matter, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner with the condition that the terms of the agreement as stated in the memo of agreement made before the Patna High Court Mediation Center would not be violated.

Let the petitioner, above named, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the Court below within four weeks, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M. 1st Class, Begusarai in connection with Complaint Case No. 302 of 2023,
subject to the condition laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure/Section 482 (2) of the B.N.S.S., 2023 with Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.74988 of 2024(4) dt.10-04-2025 further condition that the petitioner shall co-operate in the investigation/trial.
(Soni Shrivastava, J) aditya/-
